#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    std::string str;
    std::getline(std::cin, str);

    std::vector<int> runLengths;
    size_t i = 0;

    while (i < str.length()) {
        size_t start = i;
        char current = str[i];

        while (i < str.length() && str[i] == current) {
            i++;
        }

        runLengths.push_back(i - start);
    }

    int ans = 0;
    for (int length : runLengths) {
        if (length % 2 == 0) {
            ans++;
        }
    }

    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
